heading: Tasks of Commission
lead: A Commission established pursuant to this chapter shall, to the extent possible, undertake the following tasks:

tree.heading: Cause.—
tree.text: Determine the cause of the incident.

tree.heading: Contributing factors.—
tree.text: Identify all contributing factors to the cause of the incident.

tree.heading: Additional findings or recommendations.—
tree.text: Provide any additional findings or recommendations deemed by the Commission to be important, whether or not they are related to the specific incident under investigation.

tree.heading: Report.—
tree.text: Prepare a report to Congress, the President, and the public.
